context.body: Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite, who was of Bahurim, hurried and came down with the men of Judah to meet King David.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Shimei asks mercy, Mephibosheth disputes Ziba’s account, Barzillai declines reward, Chimham crosses, and Israel argues with Judah about its share in the king.
observations.label: Return brings pleas, disputed testimony, and tribal quarrel: textual observation

observations.body: The passage keeps David, Shimei, Abishai, Mephibosheth, Ziba, Barzillai, Chimham, Judah, and Israel, the Jordan crossing and Gilgal, pleading, sparing, explaining neglect, dividing land, rewarding, crossing, and disputing visible within David's story or later memory.
observations.label: Return brings pleas, disputed testimony, and tribal quarrel: action, promise, or consequence

observations.body: David, Shimei, Abishai, Mephibosheth, Ziba, Barzillai, Chimham, Judah, and Israel · the Jordan crossing and Gilgal · pleading, sparing, explaining neglect, dividing land, rewarding, crossing, and disputing · restoration settles some encounters while opening another tribal conflict
observations.label: Relationships named in 2 Samuel 19:16–43

payload.posture: Read 2 Samuel 19:16–43 as its own exile, return, and rebellion David setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: The source places restoration settles some encounters while opening another tribal conflict inside this David setting without explaining every motive, transition, or later consequence.
